fences.text: An adult male Hokkaido brown bear about 2 metres long and roughly 150 to 250 kilograms charging straight toward the camera ON ALL FOURS along a narrow forest trail near Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in early April early spring, never rearing up on its hind legs, NOT on two legs, head dropped low, jaws wrenched wide open with fangs bared, ears pinned flat, the fur along its neck bristled up, claws fully extended.
